describe: A deep, warm adult male documentary narrator with a calm, confident storytelling voice, unhurried and measured, close to the microphone, studio quality
line: In nineteen ninety four, a man quit the best job he ever had to sell books out of his garage. Everyone told him it was a mistake. He did it anyway.
made_with: openbmb/VoxCPM2 voice design (description only; no person's recording)

openai.persona:
Voice: a warm, confident male narrator of a top short-form documentary channel, telling a true story. Close to the microphone, natural and human, never an announcer, never salesy, never theatrical.
Pacing: fast and tight, about 200 words a minute while speaking; slow lines are shown with tone, not with speed; short pauses only where a sentence ends.
Melody: big, natural pitch movement, like someone telling a friend a story they can't believe: each sentence climbs to its key word and falls firmly at its end.
Stress: words written in capitals carry the line. Hit each one clearly: noticeably louder and higher than the words around it, then come straight back down.
Numbers and names land crisp and exact.
openai.chosen: 13 Nov voice study (.valmera/week-1112/lanes/VOICE): pitch range, pace and match to the reference narrators
